title: How Fast Can You Get Interim Maintenance in Court?
desc: Section 144 BNSS lets a Magistrate order interim maintenance while a maintenance case is still pending in Haldwani and Uttarakhand courts.
why: Maintenance cases can take months or years to finish, and section 144 of the BNSS exists so a dependent spouse, child or parent is not left without support until then.
keyPoints: A Magistrate can order interim maintenance under section 144 BNSS while the main maintenance case is still pending.
Wives, minor children, children with a disability, and dependent parents can claim it if they cannot maintain themselves.
The law directs courts to decide interim maintenance applications within 60 days of serving notice, as far as possible.
Non-payment can lead to a warrant for the amount as a fine, and up to one month in jail.

sections.h: What is interim maintenance under section 144 BNSS?
p: Interim maintenance under section 144 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 — which replaced section 125 of the old Criminal Procedure Code — lets a Judicial Magistrate First Class order monthly payments while a maintenance case is still being heard. Courts in Haldwani and across Uttarakhand use it so a wife, child or parent is not left without money for years until the final order. The law says such applications should, as far as possible, be decided within 60 days of the other side being served notice.

This interim order runs alongside the main case. The Magistrate looks only at the facts needed to decide interim relief, not every detail argued at the final hearing, so the amount can later increase or decrease once the case ends.
The same proviso also lets the Magistrate order the paying party to cover reasonable expenses of the proceedings (court costs and the like) separately from the monthly allowance.

sections.h: Who can ask for it, and who cannot?
p: A wife unable to maintain herself, a minor child, an adult child who cannot maintain itself because of a physical or mental disability, and a father or mother unable to maintain themselves can all apply under section 144 BNSS.

A wife loses the right to maintenance if she is living in adultery, refuses without sufficient reason to live with her husband, or the couple is living separately by mutual consent. If the husband has remarried or keeps another woman, that counts as sufficient reason for the wife to live apart.

sections.h: From when is it paid, and what if it isn't?
p: Maintenance is payable from the date of the Magistrate's order, or from the date the application was filed if the order specifically says so. This matters because even the interim stage of a maintenance case can take several months to reach.

If the paying party does not pay without sufficient cause, the Magistrate can issue a warrant to recover the amount as if it were a fine, and can order up to one month's imprisonment, or until payment, whichever comes first. An application to recover arrears must be filed within one year of the amount becoming due.

whatToDo: File the maintenance application with details of your income, expenses and dependents, and expressly ask for interim maintenance.
Keep salary slips, bank statements and expense records ready to support the amount you are claiming.
If 60 days pass after notice is served without a decision, raise the delay before the same court.
Apply to recover unpaid interim maintenance within one year of each amount falling due.

hi.title: कोर्ट में अंतरिम भरण-पोषण कितनी जल्दी मिल सकता है?
keyPoints: धारा 144 बीएनएसएस के तहत मुख्य भरण-पोषण केस लंबित रहते हुए भी मजिस्ट्रेट अंतरिम भरण-पोषण का आदेश दे सकते हैं।
पत्नी, नाबालिग बच्चे, दिव्यांग बच्चे और आश्रित माता-पिता यह दावा कर सकते हैं अगर वे खुद अपना भरण-पोषण नहीं कर सकते।
कानून के अनुसार नोटिस तामील होने के 60 दिन के भीतर, जहाँ तक संभव हो, अंतरिम आवेदन का निपटारा करना चाहिए।
भुगतान न करने पर राशि जुर्माने की तरह वसूली जा सकती है और एक महीने तक की कैद भी हो सकती है।

sources.title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 — Act No. 46 of 2023 (India Code)
